documents.title: Diagnostic Mammogram
documents.text:
FINDINGS: Irregular spiculated mass in the left breast at 2 o'clock measuring 1.9 cm.
IMPRESSION: BI-RADS 5, highly suggestive of malignancy. Biopsy recommended.

documents.title: Surgical Pathology Report
documents.text:
SPECIMEN: Left breast core biopsy.
DIAGNOSIS: Invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 2. ER positive, HER2 negative.
